rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe a person who feels the need for sleep.

rows.jyutping: ling6 jan4 ngaan5 fan3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this to describe a thing that makes people feel sleepy, such as a drink or piece of music.

example.english: This song is so sleepy that I wanted to go to sleep after a few minutes.
example.traditional: 呢首令人眼瞓嘅歌，我聽咗幾分鐘就想瞓。
